messages:
alex: :rotating_light: heads-up — canary firmware push (BMC v2.1.4 + BIOS 3.7) started in us-west1. seeing ~7 nodes from gpu-rack-54 boot into UEFI with secure-boot=ON even though our profile expects OFF. provisioning failing with PXE errors. paging @oncall
mina: same — provisioning dashboard shows 6 -> 8 nodes stuck at 'postflash - waiting for pxe'. node names: gpu-54-{03..09}. logs show `PXE: No bootable image found` then `rebooting`.
ajay: can you paste the BMC output? quick check: `ipmitool -I lanplus -H <bmc-ip> -U admin -P **** chassis bootparam get 5` will show boot flags. if secureboot flipped we can toggle via ipmi.
sasha: runbook RBN-3424 has the safe toggle steps for this exact vendor quirk. quick snippet:
```
# set secure boot off
./bmc-secureboot-toggle --host $BMC --admin-pass $PASS --secureboot off
# or use ipmitool fallback
ipmitool -I lanplus -H $BMC -U admin -P $PASS raw 0x00 0x01 0x02
```
claire: if this escalates we're looking at ~25 GPUs impacted in us-west1 if the rollout keeps going. can we pause the fleet job and divert low-priority training to us-east1? cost will bump but we need availability.
michael: i'm oncall — pausing the rollout now. kicking the rollback play (fw-v2.1.3-bios-3.6) to the canary nodes, and running the secureboot toggle script against the affected BMCs. starting diagnostics.
deploy-bot: deploy/firmware-canary job #4721 reported failures on 8 hosts: gpu-54-03,gpu-54-04,gpu-54-05,gpu-54-06,gpu-54-07,gpu-54-08,gpu-54-09,gpu-54-10 — logs uploaded to https://artifacts.internal/fw/4721/logs
mina: i grabbed a raw BMC dump from gpu-54-05 — `SecureBoot: Enabled`, `BootOrder: UEFI`, `LastProvisionState: POSTFLASH`. looks like vendor firmware toggled the efivar on flash.
ajay: temporary workaround: set `pxe.force_legacy=true` in fleet-provisioner for that rack so nodes will boot legacy PXE while we fix the secure-boot state. command: `kubectl -n provisioner patch configmap fleet-config --patch '{"data":{"pxe.force_legacy":"true"}}'` — low-risk and reversible.
alex: do the patch and add a short TTL (30m). michael, coordinate rollback. claire, please open a capacity reservation ticket with infra-sales so critical jobs keep running.
claire: opening CR-1897 now, tagging with affected racks and expected cost delta.
michael: rollback job kicked at 1719002400. running post-rollback validation: ipmi checks, reflash completion, provisioning attempts. will report progress every 10m.
ops-bot: INCIDENT INC-20241234 created (firmware-canary-failure-usw1). severity: P2. assignees: @michael, @alex, @ajay.
michael: rollback completed on the 8 canary hosts at 1719006000. secureboot reports OFF now and provisioning resumed for gpu-54-{03..09}. monitoring for 30m.
mina: provisioning queue drained, 22 GPUs back online. keeping `pxe.force_legacy=true` for 20m to catch stragglers then revert.
ajay: follow-up action items: 1) vendor confirmation on unexpected efivar toggle, 2) add preflight to firmware pipeline to check efivar state post-flash, 3) add automated revert step to run `bmc-secureboot-toggle --secureboot off` if mismatch detected.
alex: good notes. i'll sync with release engineering on gating and add a postmortem draft. thanks all for quick responses :thumbsup:
